invariants.rationale: Method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object, so result should never be null under normal operation.
HoodieWriteMetadata contains a list of WriteStatus objects representing the outcome of compaction.
compactionInstantTime should be a valid non-empty timestamp string indicating the compaction instant.
A non-null HoodieEngineContext is required for correctly executing actions.
The number of WriteStatus objects in the result should be non-negative, even for empty outcomes.
